platform_rule: No new foundational assurance module or architecture is created. Blueprints reuse the existing Platform A lifecycle and apply it to industry or enterprise contexts.
engineering_principle: A blueprint does not add architecture; it demonstrates how the existing assurance lifecycle applies to a specific operational domain.

blueprints.domain: Pharmaceutical CMC, formulation, process development, manufacturing, regulatory content, change control, and continuous assurance
blueprints.core_question: Can AI-enabled CMC activity be discovered, governed, monitored, evidenced, and continuously assured across formulation, process development, manufacturing, and regulatory content workflows?

lifecycle.stage_question: Which AI systems, models, prompts, agents, tools, or workflows are being used in CMC?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Identify AI used in formulation, process development, manufacturing decision support, regulatory content generation, and CMC workflow support.

lifecycle.stage_question: Which AI supports formulation, process development, regulatory content, or manufacturing decisions?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Make AI usage visible across CMC workflows and connect each AI activity to owner, context of use, business purpose, and evidence state.

lifecycle.stage_question: Is the AI governed according to its CMC risk, intended use, human oversight, and regulatory impact?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Classify risk, define governance obligations, verify human accountability, and connect the AI activity to CMC quality expectations.

lifecycle.stage_question: Are AI governance controls implemented in actual CMC workflows?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Connect governance to formulation review, CPP/CQA optimization, batch/manufacturing support, content generation, review, and approval workflows.

lifecycle.stage_rule: Evaluate whether AI-generated recommendations were translated into enterprise actions safely, correctly, under policy, and with complete evidence.
lifecycle.core_question: Was the AI recommendation executed safely, correctly, under policy, and with complete evidence?
execution_control_questions: Was human approval required and captured?
Can the execution be reconstructed during audit or inspection?

lifecycle.stage_question: Did AI influence manufacturing decisions, process parameters, quality attributes, deviations, or monitoring actions?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Monitor AI influence across manufacturing decisions, CPPs, CQAs, deviations, change events, and process monitoring.

lifecycle.stage_question: What evidence supports every AI-assisted CMC decision?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Bind formulation, process development, manufacturing, regulatory content, review, approval, change control, and monitoring evidence.

lifecycle.stage_question: Are CMC AI controls, evidence, monitoring, and intended use continuously refreshed?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Track lifecycle changes, intended-use changes, model updates, prompt changes, process changes, and evidence freshness.

lifecycle.stage_question: Can the AI-enabled CMC workflow be operationally trusted?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Summarize whether the AI-enabled CMC workflow is visible, governed, operationalized, monitored, evidenced, synchronized, and continuously assured.

blueprints.domain: Enterprise operating model, agentic workflows, autonomous decisions, human approvals, control execution, workflow change, evidence generation, and operational trust
blueprints.core_question: Can the enterprise operating model remain trustworthy when AI agents are embedded into business processes, autonomous decisions, workflow execution, control activity, evidence generation, and governance boundaries?

lifecycle.stage_question: Which agents exist and which business processes do they support?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Identify agents, owners, tools, data access, workflows, business processes, autonomy level, and intended use.

lifecycle.stage_question: Which agent acted, why did it act, and which data influenced the action?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Make agent activity, data influence, tool calls, prompts, decision path, and workflow impact visible.

lifecycle.stage_question: Which agent actions crossed governance boundaries or required human approval?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Classify governance boundaries, decision rights, escalation rules, human approval rules, and risk controls.

lifecycle.stage_question: Is the enterprise operating model still trustworthy after agentic workflow changes?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Evaluate business process ownership, human accountability, workflow redesign, control ownership, and operating model resilience.

lifecycle.stage_question: Which workflows changed and which controls executed?
lifecycle.operational_focus: Verify that agentic workflows execute with defined controls, approvals, exception handling, and evidence generation.
